about.title: About Howard County Public School System
about.content: Howard County Public School System, also known as HCPSS, serves students across Howard County, Maryland, including Ellicott City, Columbia, Elkridge, Laurel, Clarksville, Fulton, Savage, and nearby communities between Baltimore and Washington, D.C. This page summarizes the districtwide HCPSS dates-only school calendar published by the district.

about.title: How to Use This HCPSS Calendar
about.content: Use this page for districtwide HCPSS dates such as the first day for staff, K–12 opening day, Pre-K/RECC opening day, school closures, three-hour early closings, parent-teacher conferences, winter break, spring break, professional days, possible weather make-up days, and the scheduled last day. Individual schools may publish separate dates for testing, athletics, performances, graduation details, bell schedules, and campus events.

planningTips.title: What Howard County Families Should Check
content: HCPSS lists a separate first day for K–12 students and Pre-K/RECC students, so younger students may not follow the same opening date as older students.
Many HCPSS dates are three-hour early closings rather than full closures. Families should check whether half-day Pre-K/RECC is cancelled on those dates.
Parent-teacher conference dates can differ by level, including elementary, middle, high school, Pre-K, and RECC notes.
The calendar identifies inclement weather days near the end of the year. Some late-year early closings can become full student days if weather days are used.

districtFaqs.q: Which Howard County Public School System calendar does this page summarize?
districtFaqs.a: This page summarizes the official HCPSS dates-only school calendar for the selected school year.

districtFaqs.q: Does HCPSS use different first days for K-12 and Pre-K/RECC?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. HCPSS lists the first day of school for K–12 students separately from the first day for Pre-K/RECC students. Families with younger students should check the selected school year before arranging transportation or child care.

districtFaqs.q: What are HCPSS three-hour early closings?
districtFaqs.a: Three-hour early closings are school days with an earlier dismissal time. HCPSS uses them for professional learning, work days, parent-teacher conferences, midterm exams, and staff professional days.

districtFaqs.q: How does HCPSS handle inclement weather days?
districtFaqs.a: HCPSS lists possible inclement weather days near the end of the school year. If weather closures occur, those dates may become student attendance days or affect the final week of school.

districtFaqs.q: Does the HCPSS calendar apply to every school event?
districtFaqs.a: No. The district calendar covers systemwide school dates, closures, early closings, conferences, breaks, and weather-day notes. Schools may publish separate dates for testing, athletics, performances, graduation activities, and campus events.

districtFaqs.q: Can I add the HCPSS calendar to Google Calendar?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. Download the .ics file from this page and import it into Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook. The file is a one-time import and does not automatically sync with later HCPSS revisions.

districtFaqs.q: Where should families verify HCPSS calendar updates?
districtFaqs.a: Use the official Howard County Public School System calendar page and district announcements for final confirmation. MySchoolDates is an independent calendar reference and is not affiliated with HCPSS.
